attributes.action: Stop taxing pensioners into poverty: Exempt retirement income  to Minimum Wage.
attributes.additional_details: Taxing pensions below the Minimum Wage forces retirees into poverty, destroying independence and the affordability of necessary home care. This fuels state dependency: disability hits 45% at retirement age, with depression driving 40% of claims. Forced care home entries cost councils £951–£1,185 weekly, and NHS discharge delays cost £1.89bn annually. A tiered tax shield up to the Minimum Wage cuts welfare claims, delivering massive cost-savings.
attributes.background:
Forced state care home admissions due to pensioner poverty cost the state  £1.89 billion annually in delayed NHS discharges.  
An income tax shield up to the National Minimum Wage restores independence, reduces welfare claims, and ensures massive long term cost-savings for the state.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you mean by “an income tax shield up to the National Minimum Wage”, as the National Minimum Wage value varies depending on the number of hours worked.

You could start a new petition clearly outlining a specific figure you would like the Government or Parliament to increase the personal allowance to.

You may also wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/779321
